# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at [COMPANY NAME]. We believe your skills and experience will be valuable additions to our engineering team.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [Engineering Manager Name/Title]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

## Responsibilities

In this role, you will be expected to:

- Design, build, and maintain scalable software systems in [primary stack, e.g., Python/Go/React]
- Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions
- Mentor and provide technical guidance to mid-level and junior engineers
- Participate in code reviews, on-call rotation, and agile ceremonies
- Collaborate with product, design, and cross-functional teams
- Contribute to engineering standards, tooling, and documentation

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly/monthly]
**Bonus:** Eligible for an annual discretionary bonus of up to [X]% of base salary based on company and individual performance
**Equity:** [X] shares/options vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, subject to the Company's equity incentive plan and a separate stock option agreement

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, including:

- Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) effective [date]
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off per year
- [X] paid holidays
- Professional development stipend of $[X] per year
- [Other benefits, e.g., remote work stipend, home office equipment]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:

- Successful completion of background check
- Verification of your right to work in [Country]
- Execution of required employment documents including:
  - Confidentiality Agreement
  - Invention / Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement
  - [Non-Compete Agreement, if applicable and enforceable in your jurisdiction]

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return by [DEADLINE DATE]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our team. If you have any questions, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

*Note: This offer letter template is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. Employment laws vary by jurisdiction (for example, non-compete provisions are restricted or unenforceable in some states, including California). Consult with qualified legal counsel before finalizing and issuing this document.*

---

**Customization checklist before sending:**
- Replace all bracketed placeholders (`[DATE]`, `[COMPANY NAME]`, salary, equity, benefits, etc.)
- Confirm the non-compete item is either removed or reviewed by counsel for your jurisdiction
- Verify exempt classification with local wage-and-hour rules
- Have legal counsel review the final version per the skill's best practices
